crossRefs.note: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named…
For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve…
For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak…
Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
(but how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule one’s own house take care of God’s assembly?)

translations.web: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.
translations.bsb: So even though I wrote to you, it was not on account of the one who did wrong or the one who was harmed, but rather that your earnestness on our behalf would be made clear to you in the sight of God.
translations.kjv: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
translations.asv: So although I wrote unto you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be made manifest unto you in the sight of God.
